about: Rows whose evidence class merge-review.cjs doesn't settle by status (from 2026-10-16, the brief of that day's items 1 and 2), and each static test's standard as read: what it reaches, examples it must catch and must accept (each quoted as it's written in the test's file, which tools/coverage.mjs checks), and whether it meets the standard. A static test verifies a row only where the row's claim is the repository's own text.

i-stale-claims.why: Its claim is the repository's own text: no sentence in src/, tests/ or docs/ says the removed interests do anything now. The owner's brief of 2026-10-16 (coverage-classes-and-evidence-totals, item 2) answered the decision of 2026-10-15 (docs/verification/CURRENT-SCOPE-2026-10-15.md, The Owner's Decisions, 1) yes: such a row is verified by a gate test that reads that text, where the test reaches what the claim is about, checks it, and expects independently, with examples it must catch and examples it must accept.

was.standard: the player-action standard: only a test that issues a command, runs the clock or renders a screen verifies a row, and a test reading the tree was recorded as a fixture
was.note: 2026-10-15: the skeptic found the prose and its rule hold, but the row’s tests read the repository’s text (tree walks and examples, recorded as fixtures, as at bef4bde5); the standard verifies a row only on a command, the clock or a rendered screen, so it stays partial. Whether a gate test reading the repository may verify a row about that text is the owner’s decision.
